info.title: Conference API
info.description: Matching for conferences. Only partners' servers call it, with OAuth 2 client credentials.

pii.description: About an identifiable person: their IDs, names, ORCID iDs, attendance and credentials. Sealed field by field where stored, never logged in full, never cached, and sent only to services approved for it.

programme.description: A conference's programme and what is worked out from it: talks, sessions, their content and match reasons.

operational.description: How the API works: the IDs it makes, counts, scores, settings, times, agreement terms and refusals.

x-versioning.policy: A change that would break partners becomes a new version under a new path prefix, running alongside the old one. A retiring operation is marked deprecated here, and its answers carry Deprecation and Sunset headers and a link to its successor. It keeps every security fix until it is switched off.

post.summary: Send one talk, several, or the whole programme. All or nothing.

post.summary: Report who attended. Signed over the whole message; each report becomes one entry in a tamper-evident log.

parameters.name: Signature-Input
parameters.description: RFC 9421. Must cover @method, @authority, @path, content-digest and content-type, with created and keyid.

parameters.name: Signature
parameters.description: RFC 9421: the signature, made with one of the partner's registered keys (ed25519 or ecdsa-p256-sha256).

parameters.name: Content-Digest
parameters.description: RFC 9530: the SHA-256 digest of the body, as sha-256=:<base64>:.
